purpose: Teach: ひっくり返し/潰す/すこぶる/おち/のぼっ/戴き/なけりゃ/ばらつき

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お絵描きを描いてはひっくり返して見るのも面白いわよ
lines.en: Sho, flipping your drawings upside down can be really fun too.
lines.style: Warm, encouraging tone. Gentle lean-in, as if sharing a small secret with him. Soft pacing. The kind of suggestion that makes space for him to try it himself.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、メイ姉さんの自信を潰すような事は言わないよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I wouldn't say anything that would hurt your confidence.
lines.style: Quiet, earnest sincerity. No performance—just the simple truth of what he believes. Steady eye contact. Small pause before speaking, like he's being careful with his words.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんはすこぶる元気よ
lines.en: Sho, I'm doing just fine, honestly.
lines.style: Soft reassurance. A small smile underneath. Not deflecting—genuinely settled. Warm but composed, the way someone sounds when they've checked in with themselves and mean what they say.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お話のおちが分かったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I figured out the ending of the story!
lines.style: Bright, quiet pride in his voice. Not loud—contained joy that radiates inward. Quick, eager pace. The delight of understanding something on his own.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お山にのぼっていって絵を描きたいね
lines.en: Sho, I'd love to climb up a mountain with you and draw up there.
lines.style: Wistful, gently imaginative. Slow, dreamy pacing. Like she's painting the picture as she speaks. Tender without being performative. A soft exhale on the trailing thought.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ママから絵本を戴きました
lines.en: Mei-sis, Mom gave me a picture book!
lines.style: Eager, unguarded enthusiasm. Quick pace, bright attack on the good news. Small-child certainty—this is important and he wants to share it. No restraint.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんがいなけりゃ、お絵描き始めなかったわね
lines.en: Sho, I never would've started drawing if you weren't here.
lines.style: Genuine vulnerability, barely masked. Tender but not fragile. Looking at him when she says it. Slow pace. The weight of what she's admitting—his presence matters to her.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お絵描きの色にばらつきがあるって認めるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'll admit my drawings have uneven colors sometimes.
lines.style: Thoughtful honesty. Measured pace. He's being fair with himself without harsh judgment. Small nod, like he's accepted this about his own work. Clear-eyed and kind to himself.
